description: Check a domain's subdomains (enumerated from Certificate Transparency) for dangling-CNAME takeover risk: a CNAME that delegates to a third-party service (GitHub Pages, S3, Heroku, Azure, Netlify, …) which no longer claims the name. Status is 'vulnerable' (the service's unclaimed-page fingerprint was seen), 'dangling' (CNAME to the service but the name no longer resolves), or 'potential' (still resolves, unconfirmed). DNS-first; an HTTP GET runs only for CNAME matches, to confirm the fingerprint.
name: subdomain_takeover_check
